column1: # omarchy-browser-support — browser registry (tab separated, one browser per line)
# Every installer, remover, menu row and docs table is generated from this file.
# Edit a row, then run:  omarchy-browsers menu setup
# Columns:
#   1  name        CLI id + menu row suffix (lowercase, digits, dashes)
#   2  display     Human name shown in the menu
#   3  packages    Comma separated Arch packages; the FIRST one is primary
#                  (drives menu visibility and the installed check)
#   4  source      repo (official/omarchy repos) or aur (built through yay)
#   5  command     Executable the package provides
#   6  desktops    Comma separated .desktop ids, first one preferred
#   7  glyph       Nerd Font glyph for notifications (U+XXXX or a literal char)
#   8  menu_glyph  Optional glyph for menu rows only (U+XXXX or a literal char)
#   9  icon_font   Optional Qt font family for the menu glyph (shipped in assets/)
#  10  purge       Space separated paths under $HOME wiped by remove --purge
# Glyph codepoints (Nerd Font): helium U+F02A0, librewolf U+F059F,
# waterfox/floorp U+F269, vivaldi U+F02AF. Helium's menu rows use U+E00B from
# the bundled OmarchyHeliumIcon font (assets/), so the menu shows the real
# starburst instead of a generic globe; every other row stays on Nerd Font.
helium
librewolf
waterfox
vivaldi
floorp
